quranTranslation.text: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.

explanation.bs: „Neće mu pomoći ni imetak njegov ni ono što je zaradio“ – zarada, imetak.
explanation.en: “His wealth and gains will not exempt him” — earnings, wealth.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but whosoever hath done evil and his sin surroundeth him; such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „Ko zaradi zlo djelo…“ – كَسَبَ i za zlo.
explanation.en: Whoever earns an evil deed (كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً) — كَسَبَ for evil too.

quranTranslation.text: And covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others. Unto men a fortune from that which they have earned, and unto women a fortune from that which they have earned. (Envy not one another) but ask Allah of His bounty. Lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: Muškarcima pripada udio od onoga što zarade, i ženama od onoga što zarade – اِكْتَسَبَ bez ikakvog prizvuka zla.
explanation.en: For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women a share of what they have earned — اِكْتَسَبَ with no shade of evil.

gloss.en: to acquire, to earn for oneself

quranTranslation.text: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: Svakom od njih – grijeh koji je stekao – اِكْتَسَبَ za lično stečen grijeh.
explanation.en: For every person among them is what he has earned of the sin — اِكْتَسَبَ for a sin acquired in person.

gloss.en: to acquire, to earn for oneself

quranTranslation.text: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

explanation.bs: „I obavljajte namaz i dajite zekat“ – namaz kao propisani ibadet, uz zekat.
explanation.en: “Establish worship, pay the poor-due” — prayer as a prescribed act of worship, beside zakat.

quranTranslation.text: Take alms of their wealth, wherewith thou mayst purify them and mayst make them grow, and pray for them. Lo! thy prayer is an assuagement for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „I moli za njih, jer je tvoja molitva njima smiraj“ – u tefsiru: صَلَاة ovdje znači Poslanikovu dovu za njih.
explanation.en: “And pray for them. Lo! thy prayer is an assuagement for them” — tafsir: صَلَاة here is the Prophet's supplication for them.

quranTranslation.text: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Namaz zaista sprečava bestidnost i ono što je ružno“ – namaz kao ibadet koji oblikuje čovjeka.
explanation.en: “Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity” — prayer as worship that shapes the one who prays.

quranTranslation.text: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim moli da obavlja namaz i završava: „Gospodaru naš, i primi moju dovu“ – obje riječi u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: Abraham asks to establish worship and ends: “our Lord! and accept my prayer” (دُعَاء) — both words in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.

explanation.bs: Zekerijja: „i nikad, Gospodaru moj, nisam bio nesretan u dovi Tebi“ – dova kao lično obraćanje.
explanation.en: Zechariah: “I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord” — supplication as a personal plea.

quranTranslation.text: When We show favour unto man, he withdraweth and turneth aside, but when ill toucheth him then he aboundeth in prayer.

explanation.bs: Kad čovjeka dotakne zlo, „onda je dova njegova duga i široka“ – دُعَاء u nevolji, bez propisanog oblika.
explanation.en: When ill touches man, “then he aboundeth in prayer” — supplication in hardship, with no set form.

quranTranslation.text: Such as remember Allah, standing, sitting, and reclining, and consider the creation of the heavens and the earth, (and say): Our Lord! Thou createdst not this in vain. Glory be to Thee! Preserve us from the doom of Fire.

explanation.bs: „…i razmišljaju o tome kako su stvorena nebesa i Zemlja“ – razmišljanje o stvaranju.
explanation.en: “…and consider the creation of the heavens and the earth” — reflection on creation.

quranTranslation.text: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect.

explanation.bs: „…u tome su, zaista, znakovi za ljude koji razmišljaju“ – razmišljanje o znaku u braku.
explanation.en: “Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect” — reflection on a sign in marriage.

quranTranslation.text: Will they not then ponder on the Qur'an? If it had been from other than Allah they would have found therein much incongruity.

explanation.bs: „Zar oni ne razmišljaju o Kur'anu?“ – poziv na dubinsko promišljanje Objave.
explanation.en: “Will they not then ponder on the Qur'an?” — a call to ponder the Revelation deeply.

quranTranslation.text: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.

explanation.bs: „Knjiga blagoslovljena koju smo ti objavili da bi o njenim ajetima razmislili“ – svrha objave.
explanation.en: “(This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations” — the purpose of revelation.

quranTranslation.text: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

explanation.bs: „…pa da imaju srca kojima bi shvatali (يَعْقِلُونَ)“ – Kur'an razumijevanje pripisuje srcu.
explanation.en: “…and have they hearts wherewith to feel [yaʿqilūna: to understand]” — the Quran ascribes understanding to the heart.

quranTranslation.text: Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?

explanation.bs: „…a vi Knjigu učite? Pa zar ne shvatate?“ – razum koji bi trebao spriječiti da se jedno govori, a drugo čini.
explanation.en: “And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?” — reason that should prevent saying one thing and doing another.

quranTranslation.text: Already have We urged unto hell many of the jinn and humankind, having hearts wherewith they understand not, and having eyes wherewith they see not, and having ears wherewith they hear not. These are as the cattle - nay, but they are worse! These are the neglectful.

explanation.bs: „Srca imaju, a njima ne shvataju (لَا يَفْقَهُونَ)“ – srce koje ne pronikne.
explanation.en: “…having hearts wherewith they understand not” — a heart that does not penetrate.

quranTranslation.text: That they may understand my saying.

explanation.bs: Musa: „…da razumiju moj govor“ – dova za razumijevanje.
explanation.en: Moses: “That they may understand my saying” — a prayer to be understood.

quranTranslation.text: Or are they jealous of mankind because of that which Allah of His bounty hath bestowed upon them? For We bestowed upon the house of Abraham (of old) the Scripture and wisdom, and We bestowed on them a mighty kingdom.

explanation.bs: „Ili ljudima zavide zbog onoga što im je Allah iz Svoje blagodati podario?“
explanation.en: “Or are they jealous of mankind because of that which Allah of His bounty hath bestowed upon them?”

quranTranslation.text: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

explanation.bs: „I od zla zavidljivca kada zavist pokaže“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And from the evil of the envier when he envieth” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them. And they say: The praise to Allah, Who hath guided us to this. We could not truly have been led aright if Allah had not guided us. Verily the messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth. And it is cried unto them: This is the Garden. Ye inherit it for what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo iz grudi njihovih odstranili svaku zlobu; ispod njih rijeke teku“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru naš, oprosti i nama i našoj braći koja su nas u vjerovanju prestigla, i ne daj da u našim srcima bude zlobe prema onima koji vjeruju“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo iz grudi njihovih odstranili svaku zlobu; kao braća su na divanima, jedni prema drugima.“
explanation.en: “And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.”

quranTranslation.text: Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah, and whoso turneth away: We have not sent thee as a warder over them.

explanation.bs: „Ko se pokori Poslaniku, pokorio se Allahu …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!

explanation.bs: „… govorit će: ‚Kamo sreće da smo se pokorili Allahu i pokorili se Poslaniku!‘“ – kajanje zbog neizvršene naredbe.
explanation.en: “They say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!” — regret for commands not carried out.

quranTranslation.text: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.

explanation.bs: „Slijedite one koji od vas ne traže platu, a upućeni su!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: We follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though their fathers were wholly unintelligent and had no guidance?

explanation.bs: Kad im se kaže: „Slijedite ono što je Allah objavio“, kažu: „Ne, mi slijedimo ono u čemu smo zatekli svoje očeve“ – slijeđenje običaja, bez naredbe.
explanation.en: “Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: We follow that wherein we found our fathers” — following a custom, with no command.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Eat of that which is lawful and wholesome in the earth, and follow not the footsteps of the devil. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.

explanation.bs: „… i ne slijedite šejtanove stope“ – trag koji se ne slijedi; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “And follow not the footsteps of the devil” — a trace not to be followed; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: (A thing) whereof they have no knowledge, nor (had) their fathers, Dreadful is the word that cometh out of their mouths. They speak naught but a lie.

explanation.bs: „Teška je riječ što im iz usta izlazi …“ – jedna izreka, a velika; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Dreadful is the word that cometh out of their mouths” — a single pronouncement, and a grave one; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Perfected is the Word of thy Lord in truth and justice. There is naught that can change His words. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

explanation.bs: „I ispunila se riječ tvoga Gospodara, istinom i pravdom …“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje je ‚kelima‘ Allahova odredba, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Perfected is the Word of thy Lord in truth and justice” — ar-Rāġib: here ‘kalima’ is Allah's decree, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.

explanation.bs: „To je, zaista, govor plemenitog poslanika“ – ar-Rāġib: govor se pripisuje poslaniku jer ga on dostavlja, a i Onome Koji ga je poslao; oboje je ispravno.
explanation.en: “That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger” — ar-Rāġib: the speech is ascribed to the messenger because he conveys it, and also to the One Who sent him; both are right.

quranTranslation.text: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.

explanation.bs: „Već se nad većinom njih obistinio govor, pa oni ne vjeruju“ – ar-Rāġib: Allahovo znanje o njima i Njegova riječ protiv njih, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Already hath the judgment … proved true of most of them, for they believe not” — ar-Rāġib: Allah's knowledge of them and His word against them, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?

explanation.bs: „Je li ti stigla vijest o onome što sve prekriva?“ – kazivanje koje dolazi objavom; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?” — an account that comes by revelation; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

explanation.bs: „Neka donesu kazivanje poput njega, ako istinu govore“ – Kur'an je ovdje nazvan hadisom; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: They are told to bring an account like it, if they are truthful — here the Quran is called ḥadīth; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?

explanation.bs: „A je li ti došlo kazivanje o Musau?“ – formula kojom počinje priča.
explanation.en: “Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?” — the formula that opens a story.
